title: Atrangi Document Workspace v7.1.7
notes: Fixes missing Atrangi Riders logo visibility, makes the logo and Atrangi Document Workspace title reliably return to Home across header variants, restores a visible Light/Dark Mode control even when header markup changes, improves mobile safe-area header placement, and removes the UI dependency on a generated PNG by loading the tracked brand source directly. This release also forces a clean v7.1.7 cache refresh.
